topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: Stepping into the light drizzle, the scent of fresh blooms hits me before I even reach the door. A simple bouquet, like a splash of color against the gray. No card, no note, just petals whispering through the crack under the door. Could be anyone. But the way they're arranged, it’s not just a random act of kindness. Could be an old flame trying to kindle ashes. Could be a new admirer, testing the waters. Either way, the world feels a touch softer today, with mysteries wrapped in floral paper waiting to be unwrapped. I've seen tougher cases, but there's something in the simplicity of these flowers that makes me think maybe, just maybe, I’ve underestimated the power of a silent gesture.
